The patient-level ALB average uses only records where the UN/T-BIL ratio can also be computed, so both figures rest on the same records.

queries:
WITH sex_avg AS (
    SELECT P.SEX AS SEX,
           AVG(L.ALB) AS avg_alb,
           AVG(CAST(L.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(L.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    GROUP BY P.SEX
),
threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS thr
    FROM sex_avg
    WHERE avg_alb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - t.thr
FROM sex_avg s, threshold t
WHERE s.avg_alb > t.thr;
WITH patient_avg AS (
    SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALB) AS avg_alb
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE L.ALB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
)
SELECT ID
FROM patient_avg
WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM patient_avg);
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > (SELECT AVG(ALB) FROM Laboratory);
SELECT SEX, AVG(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) FROM Patient WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND SEX <> '' GROUP BY SEX
